resources.string: KidBox works best with your family
Invite your partner or the other family members: documents, wallet, health, expenses and calendar become shared and up to date for everyone, in real time.
Upload a document once: your whole family sees it right away, without having to ask anyone.
ID cards and tickets in your Wallet
Keep identity and travel documents, and get a reminder a week before they expire.
Your children\'s health, all in one place
Visits, tests, treatments and medical records: the full history, shared with whoever looks after them with you.
The assistant knows what you keep in KidBox: ask a question, and it can even create reminders and events for you.
One place to talk it through, right next to the documents and photos you\'re talking about.
A calendar you both can see
Appointments, sports, birthdays: who\'s going, when, and who\'s taking care of it. Without chasing each other over messages.
Occasional suggestions about features you haven\'t tried yet.
KidBox can\'t send you notifications because they\'re turned off in your system settings. Tap to re-enable them.

Created by AI from your health data

In this section the AI assistant creates a personalised meal plan from the information already in Health: medical visits, ongoing treatments, lab tests and exams, weight, height, age and the workouts recorded in Health Connect.

You get an estimate of your maintenance calories, a realistic deficit, protein, carb and fat targets, meals with portions and alternatives, high-protein snacks, pre- and post-workout options, hydration guidance, a shopping list and a 90-day progression.
The plan is educational: always validate it with your doctor or dietitian.
Weight and height are required: update them in Health Connect, in the Medical Card, or enter them manually below.

Workouts built by AI on your health data
The assistant builds a monthly training plan from what is already in Health: age, weight, height, medical reports, ongoing conditions, treatments and recorded workouts.
You get four weeks of sessions on the days you choose, with exercises and measurable goals, reminders with Done and Move buttons, and automatic matching with the workouts recorded by Health Connect.
The AI adapts intensity and exercises to the contraindications it finds in your clinical data.
The plan is educational: always validate it with your doctor. Stop training if pain appears.
The Fitness Plan is available only with a paid plan. Upgrade to Pro or Max to generate it with AI.
Weight and height are required: update them in Health Connect, in the Medical Record, or enter them during setup.
